meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 启动后,Claude 会自任组长,召集 5 名彼此敌对的成员互相攻击各自的方案,只保留经得起批驳的见解,然后强制交给 plan 智能体整理成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“adversarial plan”等触发词,或要求进行高严谨度规划时;还需满足 team 工具可用、以 sisyphus 身份在主会话运行等硬性前提。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这个项目
hpp,帮我对现有方案做敌意交叉评审
say.note: 5 名成员会互批并产出报告

say.text: 请用 adversarial plan 模式制定执行计划
say.note: 计划会交给 plan 智能体正式整理

howto.what_en: Once triggered, Claude announces "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", acts as lead of 5 hostile members who attack each other's findings, keeps surviving insights, then hands them to the plan agent to formalize an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "hyperplan", "hpp", "adversarial plan", or when maximum-rigor planning is requested; also requires team tools available, running as sisyphus in the main session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this project
say_en.note: Enters adversarial planning and prints HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: hpp, run a hostile cross-critique on my current plan
say_en.note: Five members critique each other, then a distilled report is produced

say_en.text: Please make an executable plan in adversarial plan mode
say_en.note: The distilled insights are handed to the plan agent
